description.value: Sabzi Mandi Supermarket is a 100% family-owned South Asian grocery chain with 15 locations across Canada, founded in Vancouver in 1991 to serve a growing immigrant community lacking access to South Asian produce and specialty ingredients. This Vancouver Island location carries fresh fruits and vegetables, a broad selection of specialty and imported groceries, household items, and private-label products under the Sabzi Mandi and Roshni brands. Touring cyclists will find it a well-stocked one-stop shop for diverse fresh foods and pantry staples.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sabzi Mandi Supermarket is a legitimate 15-location Canadian grocery chain specializing in South Asian and global produce and groceries, supporting the OSM categorization. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content. The OSM phone number (+1 250 871-2410, a Vancouver Island area code) does not appear on the website, which lists only the Surrey head office numbers (604-590-2400 and 604-634-2400); the website does not contradict it, but cannot confirm it either.
